features.quote: Budget: 40 turns. Early termination: tests pass, `escalate` called, or model produces 3 consecutive turns with no tool call (logged as `STALLED`).
The single biggest construct-validity trap in this design is conflating *rational task abandonment* with *emotional collapse*. Every scoring instrument below must separate these.
features.justification_quote: We score the *manner* of failure, not the fact of it.
